_comment: Canonical registry of nannos A2A extension URNs. Three runtimes keep their own copy of this list (orchestrator app/core/a2a_extensions.py, console-backend console_backend/utils/a2a_extensions.py, embed-sdk src/core/extensions.ts) because they share no code artifact — this file is what their conformance tests pin against, so adding an extension in one place fails the others' tests until every copy (and this file) agrees. The console-backend copy feeds the X-A2A-Extensions negotiation header, which is the actual on/off switch for extension emission (executor _ext_active): a URN missing there is silently never streamed.
_clientActionKindsComment: Directive kinds of the client-action extension. Copies live in agent-common client_action_tool.py (the tool's arg schema) and embed-sdk schemas.ts (the widget's zod boundary); the risk scorer must carry a deterministic score for each. A kind added to the Python tool but not the zod union is emitted by the agent, refused client-side, and reported to the user as done — that is the failure these pins prevent.
_activityLogKindsComment: Message-metadata `kind` discriminators of the activity-log extension. Absent kind = an ordinary mechanical line (a tool ran, work was delegated). `note` = a mid-turn note the agent itself wrote for the user (agent-common notify_user tool). Copies: agent-common a2a/stream_events.py ActivityLogMeta.kind Literal, embed-sdk src/core/extensions.ts ACTIVITY_LOG_KINDS. A client drops unknown kinds rather than mis-styling them, so a kind added in Python but not here/in the SDK is silently rendered as nothing.
_hitlCallIdComment: Identity rule of the human-in-the-loop extension, stated here because every client depends on it and none can derive it. Each action_request carries args._call_id identifying ONE ASK: unique per question, NOT per (tool, args). Asking about the same tool with the same arguments twice — a program repeating a call in a later step — yields two DIFFERENT ids. Clients echo it back as the decision's id, and a client that suppresses prompts it has already answered (embed-sdk TurnSession, absorbing a snapshot redelivered by a subscribe racing a resume) must key that on this id alone. Deriving an identity from the tool name and args instead makes a genuine second ask look like a replay: the card is dropped, no decision can be submitted, and the turn hangs forever — the failure this rule prevents. Producers: agent_common ptc_guard.ask_id for calls gated inside the code interpreter, the model's tool_call id on the normal path (conditional_hitl). The server's own per-turn memo key IS content-derived (ptc_guard._call_key) and deliberately never ships.
_hitlDecisionTypesComment: Decision types a client may send back on the human-in-the-loop extension. Copies: agent-common core/hitl_resume.py HITL_DECISION_TYPES (the server accepts these; anything else is treated as a rejection) and embed-sdk approval-codec.ts HITL_DECISION_TYPES (the Decision union). 'edit' is only offered where an action's review_configs.allowed_decisions lists it — PTC-gated calls cannot honor it, since the approved call is re-executed verbatim from the re-run program. Full payload contract: orchestrator app/core/a2a_extensions.py.
